- Set the title to exactly `This might seem unnecessary, but it's possible!`.

- Save the figure at 120 dpi.

{"command": "cat <<'EOF' > plot.py
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.sankey import Sankey

links_per_side = 8


def side(sankey, n=1):
    """Generate a side chain."""
    prior = len(sankey.diagrams)
    for i in range(0, 2 * n, 2):
        sankey.add(flows=[1, -1], orientations=[-1, -1], patchlabel=str(prior + i), prior=prior + i - 1, connect=(1, 0), alpha=0.5)
        sankey.add(flows=[1, -1], orientations=[1, 1], patchlabel=str(prior + i + 1), prior=prior + i, connect=(1, 0), alpha=0.5)


def corner(sankey):
    """Generate a corner link."""
    prior = len(sankey.diagrams)
    sankey.add(flows=[1, -1], orientations=[0, 1], patchlabel=str(prior), facecolor="k", prior=prior - 1, connect=(1, 0), alpha=0.5)


fig = plt.figure(figsize=(10, 8))
ax = fig.add_subplot(1, 1, 1, xticks=[], yticks=[], title="This might seem unnecessary, but it's possible!", position=[0.05, 0.05, 0.9, 0.99])
sankey = Sankey(ax=ax, unit=None)
sankey.add(flows=[1, -1], orientations=[0, 1], patchlabel="0", facecolor="red", rotation=60)
side(sankey, n=links_per_side)
corner(sankey)
side(sankey, n=links_per_side)
corner(sankey)
side(sankey, n=links_per_side)
corner(sankey)
side(sankey, n=links_per_side)
sankey.finish()
fig.savefig("figure.png")
EOF
"}
